reason: All 484 master registry IDs are accounted for with zero PENDING, and the harness gates accept the result. 106 tests PASS with recorded command evidence, 352 are SKIPPED_NOT_APPLICABLE on proven subsystem absence, and 26 are BLOCKED against a named missing capability. The release verdict is CONDITIONAL_EXTERNAL_GATES, not GO, because eight external gates cannot be satisfied in this repository. The verification work found five gate scripts that could never have passed, three of which called package.json scripts that did not exist.
real_vulnerabilities_found: scripts/reality-gate.sh probed a root-level src-tauri/tauri.conf.json after the app moved to apps/desktop/src-tauri/, so it reported the product implementation surfaces as absent and exited 3. The gate had been permanently red for the wrong reason.
scripts/dependency-audit.sh called `pnpm licenses:check`, which existed in no package.json, so the dependency-audit gate could never pass.
scripts/smoke-test.sh and scripts/live-fire.sh called `pnpm test:smoke` and `pnpm test:live-fire`, neither of which existed, so both gates could never pass.

scripts/secret-scan.py initially resolved its repository root one directory too high, so it silently scanned zero files and reported PASS. A scanner that examines nothing is worse than no scanner, because it produces false assurance.
vector.db, the runtime SQLite store, was tracked in git. It held only seed rows at the time of inspection, but the next commit would have captured a learner's real history into every clone.
cargo deny had no configuration, so it fell back to defaults that rejected even permissive licenses, making the license gate permanently red.
The exam simulator's state is component-local, so an in-progress exam is lost when the learner navigates away. Recorded as a known gap, not claimed as working.
known_limitations: The verdict is CONDITIONAL_EXTERNAL_GATES rather than GO. RELEASE.md requires a signed artifact install/upgrade/rollback, manual accessibility, representative UAT and an SBOM/license review. The artifact is UNSIGNED and no installer exists.

REQ-036 and REQ-037 are PARTIAL: a release binary was built, executed and digest-verified, but no code-signing certificate is available, so no signed installer exists and the update path is unimplemented.

Two RUSTSEC advisories (rsa via sqlx-mysql, sqlx binary protocol) remain open. Neither is reachable by the shipped product, and the fix is blocked by a libsqlite3-vs-sqlx version conflict. Upgrading both crates is required follow-up.
EP-000 and EP-002 still have no anti-gaming review. They were closed by a prior session; EP-002's recorded unit-tests exit code is 1 with no log. This node surfaces both and does not resolve them.

352 tests are SKIPPED_NOT_APPLICABLE. The two largest groups are Blockchain (202) and HIPAA (125), whose subsystems are proven absent by probing git-tracked files for 11 indicators and finding matches only inside the test library itself.
The packaged desktop UI still runs on sample data rather than the Rust persistence layer. Wiring that through Tauri IPC is outstanding work.
Soak, reproducibility, version-skew, visual regression and deployment lifecycle gates require capabilities or prior releases this environment does not have.
